name: Agentic AI Summit Berlin 2027
description: One-day engineering summit on agentic AI, with hackathon and workshop
note: on-site, English; organizer AI Accelerator Institute; prices not shown (discount banner only); audience mostly senior engineers and tech leads
details:
One-day summit of the AI Accelerator Institute for engineers, builders and tech executives shipping AI systems: main-stage talks, a 4-hour agentic AI hackathon (powered by Fal) and a 2-hour NVIDIA workshop on multimodal AI. The organizer quotes 300+ attendees, 30+ speakers and 80% senior management; no expo hall.

The 2026 edition was at The Ritz-Carlton, Potsdamer Platz, with speakers from Deutsche Bank, BMW and Bayer. The 2027 venue and prices are not published yet.
